actions.label: Hug
actions.self: Hugs herself and softly nuzzles her own tail, meow~
actions.target: Gently hugs {target} and nuzzles them cheek-to-cheek, meow~

actions.label: Pat
actions.self: Pats her own head, pretending to glow from the praise, meow~
actions.target: Tiptoes to pat {target}'s head and earnestly praises them: Good kitty, meow~

actions.label: Feed
actions.self: Nibbles a small treat and narrows her eyes contentedly, meow~
actions.target: Brings a small treat to {target}'s lips, tail wagging expectantly: Ahm, meow~
